mutants.name: leading_zero_as_digit
mutants.desc: digit DP that treats padded leading zeros as real digits (requires |0 - first digit| == 1)

mutants.name: low_exclusive
mutants.desc: returns f(high) - f(low) (forgets to include low itself when low is a stepping number)

mutants.name: same_length_only
mutants.desc: digit DP forces the first digit nonzero, so only counts numbers with as many digits as the bound

mutants.name: tight_reset
mutants.desc: digit DP with tight flag updated as (d == limit) instead of (tight and d == limit)

mutants.name: zero_counted
mutants.desc: counts f(high) - f(low-1) where f includes 0 as a stepping number, but low-1 == 0 is special-cased to 0
